title: Opening, closing and duplicating in Music and Classes never acts on a stale or hidden request
acceptance: openPlaylist ignores a late reply for a playlist no longer shown and clears the songs on Back, so Start class never creates class B with A's songs (lane-B repro passes).
Duplicate runs through useAsyncAction: it shows pending state and an error message, and a repeat tap does not make a second copy (lane-B repro passes).
Closing the playlist or likes dialog during Creating does not navigate the instructor into the new class later; the recommended behavior is to skip navigation and show a toast.
TrackPreview Reconnect writes a destination:'builder' return record and catches failures; a new test covers the return record. The e2e smoke is unchanged.

resolution: Built in batch #808 on branch fix/rf-111-stale-hidden-requests. (1) The Music saved-playlist dialog's openPlaylist keeps a request id: a reply, error or finally for a playlist no longer shown is ignored, and Back bumps the id and clears the songs and the loading state, so Start class can no longer create class B with A's songs or enable Start on A's songs under B's heading. (2) Classes › Recents row menu Duplicate runs through one useAsyncAction for the whole list: while a copy runs the menu item reads 'Duplicating…' and is disabled, a repeat tap is a no-op, and a failure reaches the Dashboard error line (ClassesHome gained an onError prop). useAsyncAction now reports through errMessage, so a blank or non-Error failure shows 'Something went wrong.' instead of nothing. (3) The owner's call quoted in #808: closing the playlist dialog or the likes 'Create a class' sheet (SongPickCreateDialog, which replaced the audit's LikesBrowserDialog) during Creating skips the navigation into the new class and shows a toast, 'Class created: <title>', in a bottom role=status region that clears after 6 s. A dialog left open still opens the class as before; the import result banner is unchanged. (4) TrackPreview takes returnTo {userId, classId}; its Reconnect writes a destination:'builder' return record before the provider redirect, connection-return accepts 'builder' only with a classId, and the OAuth return reopens that class in the builder. The interrupted-preview Reconnect button catches a failed start silently (no new copy), leaving the button to try again; the Spotify playback-scope Reconnect keeps its existing error line. The e2e smoke is unchanged. The SPA startup entry is 179.59 kB gzip against 179.17 kB for main 25a4b81 built in the same session (+0.42 kB, 0.41 kB under the 180 kB budget). No API, contract, schema or provider-code change; CI cannot prove a real provider OAuth round trip back into the builder.
